description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching and processing FRED TIPS yields data, including query parameter models, data models, and a fetcher class with methods for data extraction and transformation.

classes.name: FredTipsYieldsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for query parameters specific to FRED TIPS yields, including maturity, frequency, aggregation method, and transformation options.

classes.name: FredTipsYieldsData
classes.description: Data model for FRED TIPS yields data, extending the generic TipsYieldsData.

classes.name: FredTipsYieldsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving and processing FRED TIPS yields data, including methods for transforming queries, extracting data asynchronously, and transforming raw data into structured results.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FredTipsYieldsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes FRED TIPS yields data based on query parameters and credentials, returning a structured dictionary with records and metadata.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionary into an AnnotatedResult containing a list of FredTipsYieldsData instances and metadata.
